**Todo app is live and public**

Your stdlib-only HTTP todo server is exposed on your LAN and now also published to the public internet via a tunnel.

Heads up: The public link is reachable by anyone on the internet who has it. It tears down automatically when the preview closes.

Buttons:
- [Open preview] -> http://192.0.2.10:8100/__preview/fixture-tok-8000
- [Open the public link] -> https://fixture-tunnel.example/__preview/fixture-tok-8000
Done — the todo app is public. Send your cofounder the 'Open the public link' button; it stays live until you close the preview.
